title: Direct restriction comparisons on the inverse image opens of a union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W,V opens, and choose derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] in Hom universe w on X,W,V,W intersect V,and Y=W union V. Put U=Y.ι inverse image W and T=Y.ι inverse image V. There exist derived localizations in the same universe on U,T and U intersect T, equivalences eW:D(U)→D(W), eV:D(T)→D(V), and eI:D(U intersect T)→D(W intersect V), and natural isomorphisms RU eW≅PW, RT eV≅PV, RI eI≅PI. Here RU,RT,RI are direct restrictions from Y and PW,PV,PI are the overlap restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] inside X from Y to W,V,W intersect V. This asserts direct comparison data only, with no overlap comparison or pasting identity.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-mayer-vietoris-hom; explicit restriction comparison expansion using Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf; derived extension-by-zero adjunction from Tag 08BT, lemma-adjoint-lower-shriek-restrict

proof.text: Use nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization on Y. The private transportDerived construction transports local w-smallness along the exact Modules.overEquiv equivalence to the standard derived category on each open, then hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall gives hU,hT,hI in universe w. No adjunction for direct image is used.

The canonical scheme isomorphisms Opens.isoOfLE identify the inverse images of W,V,W intersect V under Y.ι with those opens. Their exact module equivalences derive to eW,eV,eI. Compare direct restriction to each inverse image followed by the equivalence with overlap restriction inside X, by overFunctorEquiv, overMapCompOverEquiv, restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorCongr. Derive the resulting natural isomorphisms using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso.

lean.statement:
theorem open_union_restriction_comparison_data
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    :
    let PW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_left : W ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let PV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
      (homOfLE le_sup_right : V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let U := (W ⊔ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let T := (W ⊔ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V
      ∃ hU : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hU
      ∃ hT : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hT
      ∃ hI : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (U ⊓ T).toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
      letI := hI
      let RU := (schemeOpenRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme U).mapDerivedCategory
      let RT := (schemeOpenRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme T).mapDerivedCategory
      ∃ (eW : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ≌ schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme)
        (eV : schemeDerivedCategory T.toScheme ≌ schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
        (_qW : RU ⋙ eW.functor ≅ PW) (_qV : RT ⋙ eV.functor ≅ PV),
      ∃ (eI : schemeDerivedCategory (U ⊓ T).toScheme ≌
          schemeDerivedCategory (W ⊓ V).toScheme),
        Nonempty ((schemeOpenRestriction (W ⊔ V).toScheme (U ⊓ T)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          eI.functor ≅ (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left) : W ⊓ V ⟶ W ⊔ V)).mapDerivedCategory)
